relationships.subject: hemiplegic shoulder pain
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP, IL-10, and IL-2 were significantly upregulated in shoulder pain group compared with control (p < .01)

relationships.subject: hemiplegic shoulder pain
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas NGF, TNF-α, IL-6, 5-HT, PGE2, SP, LPA, BK, and IL-1β were significantly decreased (p < .01)

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF‐α, IL‐1β, and IL‐6 can further induce the production of COX‐2 and increase PGE2

key_findings: Serum CGRP, IL-2 and IL-10 were higher in hemiplegic shoulder pain patients, while NGF, TNF-alpha, IL-6, 5-HT, PGE2, SP, LPA, BK and IL-1beta were lower.
Authors conclude CGRP may be the major pain mediator and HSP may not be inflammatory pain.
